# OpenVR SDK

`openvr_api.cs`, `openvr_api.dll` (win64), and `LICENSE-OpenVR` are unmodified
files from https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr at commit
`0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05`.
The managed binding and native DLL must be updated together. Do not edit the
generated binding. Its nullable diagnostics are excluded as generated code.
